extraction.notes: RUN-2026-02 comparator step (LIM-0048), RI-FMW-015 only, under LIM-0049; Croatian passages machine translated (LIM-0050), English used where the report has an English version (pages 8 and 79). Screened in full for kartic, iskaznic, EKZO, certifikat, European Health Insurance, card, CEZIH and pristupanje. Six items: readiness at accession, regional EHIC issuing figures (Rijeka, Split; no national total found), the issuing arrangement for foreign and defence ministry officials, the HZZO service that issues national and European cards, and EHIC use by EU visitors after accession. items.stated_text: HZZO je nakon višegodišnjih napornih priprema za prilagodbu europskoj legislativi na svim organizacijskim razi - nama uspješno dočekao ulazak u EU, te je bez većih prepreka počeo funkcionirati kao ravnopravni član svih europskih tijela u području koordinacije sustava socijalne sigurnosti.
items.translation_en: After many years of hard preparation to adapt to European legislation at all organisational levels, HZZO successfully met EU accession and began to function without major obstacles as an equal member of all European bodies in the field of social security coordination.
